name: Aberdeen Roland
original_name: アバディーン・ローランド
source: Apprentice of Mise and brother-like person for Agnes. Suddenly appeared along with Avril, with the purpose of taking Minette's Anima Perla. Has several combat-use Artifacts, and he himself has become an automata, using his family transmitted techniques.
translation: Apprentice of Mise and brother-like person for Agnes. Suddenly appeared along with Avril, with the purpose of taking Minette's Anima Perla. Has several combat-use Artifacts, and he himself has become an automata, using his family transmitted techniques.
